name: EarningFram
summary: ENF_ETHLEV ERC4626 withdraw is reentered via ETH callback to withdraw assets twice against stale share accounting.
notes: The last of three pre-exploit Upgraded events restored implementation 0x863e572b215fd67c855d973f870266cf827aea5e.

The trace records 320.599641877332363469 ETH deposited into the strategy and 479.923910711430215720 ETH returned by the two reentrant withdrawals, for an exact strategy net loss of 159.324268834097852251 ETH.
